title: Hy O Medha Mazloom Baba
body:
(Zalim Di Tak Kay Jafa, Deway Sada, Sada Nahi Koyi Aasra)
<<DIVIDER>>
Hy O Medha Mazloom Baba Dhee Tedhi Ku Nay Ronay Denday.
<<DIVIDER>>
Laash Tay Aan Han Pathar Hatendi Koul Mekhu Nahi Ronay Denday ( X2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Jain Bhira Tay Bahou Manr Hay Kyun Ni Aya Teda Veer Ghazi (x2)
Chacha Turiya Wal Na Hi Muriya Dhi Tedi Day Eho Wainr Anday (x2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Ro Na Bachri Enjh Kaar Kay Vain Ay Akhay Ro Ro Ghazi Di Bhen Ay (x2)
Veer Kus Aye Shabbir Kus Gay Pa Kay Rasiyan Paye Shaam Wenday (x2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Na Hi Qasim Na Raye Jo Akbar Lutt Gaye Ay Hun Saar Di Chadaar (x2)
Lagiyaan Bhayi Kiwain Bhujaeen Bay Haya Pay Bau Zulam Dhendhi (x2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Rasan Pa Kay Jada Medi Sain Ay Ro Ro Akhay Baba Hussain Ay (x2)
Jhinkay Jhaliyan Turr Shaam Chaliyan Kol Teday Nay Rouhn Denday (x2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Khakan Saar Wich Baba Rowaiyan Laash Tedi Tay Aay Satiyaan (x2)
Waikh Maidi Rukhsar Zakhmi Daard Mekhu Nay Soun Denday (x2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Hy O Zalim Meday Durr Lahavay Konr Lutday Meday Durr Bachaway (x2)
Chacha Waliya Na Baba Waliya Dhi Tedi Koo Jhinka Na Denday (x2)
